name: KTI Landmark Berhad
overview: 2026年可获取的公告主要为财务报告、股息派发及公司秘书变更等事项，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或合约签订。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长47.2%，净利润同比下降31.6%。
overview_en: The announcements available for 2026 mainly cover financial reports, dividend payment, and change of company secretary, with no disclosure of expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or contract signing for any business segment. The latest quarter (30 June 2026) saw revenue increase 47.2% year-on-year while net profit decreased 31.6%.
